verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੬ : ਹੋਰ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 6 : hor sirashaTee te gurmukhaa(n) dhaa pharak

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੇ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: jatee satee chir jeevane saadhik sidh naath gur chele|

en.bdb: Many are the celebates, the abiders of truth, the immortal ones, the siddhs,  nathas, and the teachers and the taughts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਰਿਖੀਸੁਰਾ ਭੈਰਉ ਖੇਤ੍ਰਪਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਮੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev rikheesuraa bhairau khetrapaal bahu mele|

en.bdb: Many are the goodesses, gods, rsis, bhairavs and the protectors of the regions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਅਪਛਰਾ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਜਛ ਚਲਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਖੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: gan ga(n)dharab apachharaa ki(n)nar jachh chalit bahu khele|

en.bdb: Many are the gans  (ghosts), gandharvs (celestial singers), nymphs, and kinnars who perform  differently.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਸ ਦਾਨੋਂ ਦੈਤ ਲਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: raakhas dhaano(n) dhait lakh a(n)dhar dhoojaa bhaau dhuhele|

en.bdb: Imbued with duality, many are the raksasas, the demons and  the giants.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਸ ਕੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: haumai a(n)dhar sabh ko gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat ras kele|

en.bdb: All are controlled by the ego and the Gurmukhs take pleasure  in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: eik man ik araadhanaa gurmat aap gavai suhele|

en.bdb: There they, accepting the Guru's wisdom, shed  away their selfhood.

(In India while going to get married the girl applies  oil to her hair and understands well that now she is going to leave her  parental home) Similarly Gurmukhs always having oil applied to their  heads are ever ready to depart from this world.
